Course Title: Principles of Software Engineering
Course Code: SE201

Description:
Fundamental concepts in software architecture, testing, and lifecycle management.

Learning Objectives:
- Master version control and Git workflows.
- Apply automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
- Understand design patterns and SOLID principles.

Weekly Schedule:
Week 1: Version Control & Agile
- Git fundamentals and branch workflows
- Scrum principles

Week 2: Software Testing
- Unit testing with frameworks
- Test-driven development

Assessment:
- Weekly Labs: 30%
- Project Milestone: 30%
- Final Exam: 40%
